name: Ethotoin
halfLifeNotes: Six healthy adult volunteers, single 1000 mg oral dose of the racemate (enantiomer half-lives 12.35 and 12.28 h, ~12.3 h used); shorter values (~5 h) are reported in enzyme-induced epileptic patients (pmid:42344) and kinetics are dose-dependent; value stated in the abstract — full text could not be retrieved.
